Actors Allege Casting Couch Experiences in Entertainment Industry

Actors Vijay Varma and Akanksha Puri have spoken out about experiencing casting couch situations. Varma recounted an incident where a coordinator touched him inappropriately during his early career. Puri described a demand for sexual favors from a prominent figure in exchange for help during a beauty pageant.
